name: com.polyphase.build.target.psp
author: Justin Jaro
description: Adds a 'Sony PSP (PSPSDK)' build target to the Polyphase editor. Compiles via PSPSDK (mips-allegrex-gcc), wraps the ELF + PARAM.SFO + ICON0/PIC1 into an EBOOT.PBP via pack-pbp, launches in PPSSPP or deploys to real hardware via pspsh. On Linux/macOS the toolchain runs natively against $PSPDEV; on Windows it runs inside WSL2 (pspdev publishes no native Windows binaries) — install WSL2 + Ubuntu, then install pspdev inside WSL.
